environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster, namespace 'api-services'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy applied at tier 'platform-security' (order 100) with a deny rule for egress matching destination CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all protocols. Additionally, a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-egress' with spec.podSelector matching label app=graphql-api, policyTypes=['Egress'], with egress rules allowing only DNS (UDP/53 to kube-dns) and TCP/4000 to federation-gateway pod selector. The Calico policy uses applyOnForward:true and preDNAT:false. Node-level iptables FORWARD chain has a DROP rule for packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254 inserted by a DaemonSet running in hostNetwork mode. IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required) with hop limit 1 (preventing container access even if network path existed).
